
{{alias}}( str1, str2 )
    Concatenates two strings.

    Parameters
    ----------
    str1: string
        First string.

    str2: string
        Second string.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string
        Concatenated string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( 'Hello ', 'World!' )
    'Hello World!'

    See Also
    --------
